name: C.D. Besadny Conservation Fund
summary: Annual small grants for conservation and education projects that benefit Wisconsin's lands, waters and wildlife, with priority for imperiled species and natural communities and climate resilience.

calls.label: Annual round
calls.recurring: Applications due each year by 1 September

status.quote: Submit all materials to NRFgrants@WisConservation.org by September 1st.

recurring.quote: Submit all materials to NRFgrants@WisConservation.org by September 1st.

applicant_types.quote: Applicant must be one of the following: a public charity with approved 501(c)(3) exempt status (under section 509(a)(1), 509(a)(2), or 509(a)(3) Type I and Type II); a federal, state, or local governmental unit, an American Indian nation or tribal community; or an accredited college or university.

geography.quote: conservation and education projects that benefit Wisconsin's lands, waters, and wildlife

access.quote: Complete the application (paper copies of applications are not accepted).

window.quote: Submit all materials to NRFgrants@WisConservation.org by September 1st.

co_finance_required.quote: A one-to-one match is encouraged, but not required.
